phrase: I want my dog to do a bullet time thingy when I throw him a bone, dramatically
interpretation: 'Bullet time' is a frozen-moment arc: time almost stops while the camera moves.
'Dramatic' is not one technique. It is a choice of camera position, lens, light and speed.
subject: a scruffy brown dog
action: at the top of a jump, about to catch a thrown bone

options.label: A
options.plain: Time almost stops and the camera sweeps part of the way around the subject.
options.movement: a fast, smooth arc of about 130 degrees around the subject: it starts behind the shoulder, passes the profile and stops at a front three-quarter view; it never reaches a view straight in front
options.placement: at the subject's own height, the lens level, 2 to 3 m away, on one side of the action for the whole move
options.lens_why: Wide enough to feel the camera travel past the background, not so wide that bodies bend at the frame edge.

light.name: One hard low sun, camera facing into the light
light.plain: A single low, hard sun behind the subject. The camera looks toward it.
light.prompt: one hard low sun as the only strong light, behind the subject; the camera faces into the light; bright rims on hair and shoulders, long shadows that fall toward the lens, about a third of the frame in deep true shadow

grade.name: Film print, deep blacks
grade.plain: Looks like real film: fine grain, true black shadows, natural colour.
grade.prompt: photochemical film look: fine grain, deep true blacks with detail, natural skin and material colours, restrained saturation

speed.name: Frozen moment
speed.plain: Time almost stops while the camera keeps moving.
speed.prompt: time almost stops: the subject drifts only a hand's width while the camera moves fast; real gravity returns at the end of the move
speed.still: everything caught perfectly sharp at one instant: dust and small debris hang still in the air

options.feel: The viewer gets a held breath: one instant, seen from more than one side.
options.when: One peak moment in the whole piece: the top of a jump, the instant before a landing or a hit.
risks: A full 180 or 360 degree orbit turns faces into the lens and flips left and right on screen. Ask for about 130 degrees.
Generators let frozen bodies float upward. Write 'real gravity, drifting only a hand's width'.
The background behind the subject is invented during the move. Keep the place simple.
options.still: the camera is at the middle of its arc, exactly side-on: the subject in clean profile at their own height
options.snippet: {subject} {action}; time almost stops while the camera sweeps a fast, smooth arc of about 130 degrees around them at their own height, lens level, from behind the shoulder past the profile to a front three-quarter view
options.recommended_because: It is the closest match to your words. Best for: one peak moment in the whole piece: the top of a jump, the instant before a landing or a hit.

LIGHT: one hard low sun as the only strong light, behind the subject; the camera faces into the light; bright rims on hair and shoulders, long shadows that fall toward the lens, about a third of the frame in deep true shadow.

options.label: B
options.plain: The camera sits on the floor with a wide lens and looks along the ground. The subject towers.
options.movement: locked: the camera does not move, the action comes to it
options.placement: on the floor, 3 m away, the lens level and looking along the ground into the light
options.lens_why: An ultra-wide lens on the floor makes the ground rush to the lens and gives a small jump real scale.

light.name: Silhouette with a rim
light.plain: The subject is a dark shape against a bright opening, with a thin edge of light.
light.prompt: the subject as a near-black silhouette against one bright opening, a thin hard rim of light on the edge of the body, the shape readable, more than a third of the frame in deep shadow

grade.name: Bleach bypass
grade.plain: Harsh and silvery: strong contrast, washed-out colour.
grade.prompt: bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain

speed.name: Slow motion (one beat)
speed.plain: The moment is stretched. Use it for one moment in the whole piece.
speed.prompt: slow motion for this one beat only; real gravity, weight and cloth move truthfully, nothing floats
speed.still: a crisp frame from slow motion: dust, cloth and hair caught sharp in mid-movement

options.feel: Scale and power. The subject is bigger than the viewer.
options.when: A landing, an entrance, the top of a jump. It makes a modest real jump look heroic.
risks: Do not tilt the lens up at the face: it bends bodies and generators stretch them. Keep the lens level.
Slow motion plus a jump invites floating. Write a real height and real gravity.
options.still: the camera is on the floor with the lens level: the ground stretches from the bottom edge of the frame to the subject, who is seen from the side against the light, with a lot of floor in the foreground
options.snippet: {subject} {action}, seen from a locked camera on the floor with an ultra-wide lens, the lens level, looking along the ground into the light
slop_avoided: Eye-level medium shot as the default

options.label: C
options.plain: Normal speed, a short slow-down at the best instant, then normal speed again.
options.movement: a side-on tracking move that travels with the subject at their speed
options.placement: side-on at hip height, 4 m away, travelling parallel to the action
options.lens_why: A normal lens side-on keeps body shapes true while the speed change does the work.

light.name: Low hard side sun
light.plain: Late sun from one side. One half of everything is lit, one half is dark.
light.prompt: low, hard late-afternoon sun from one side only; one side of the subject lit, the other side in real shadow; long hard-edged shadows across the ground

grade.name: Cool and desaturated
grade.plain: Cold, quiet, a little grey-blue. Serious.
grade.prompt: cool desaturated grade: grey-blue shadows, neutral skin, low saturation, soft contrast with true blacks

speed.name: Speed ramp
speed.plain: Normal speed, a short slow-down at the peak, then back to normal speed.
speed.prompt: real time into the move, a short ramp to slow motion at the peak of the action, then back to real time before the landing or the contact
speed.still: the frame at the peak of the action, the body sharp, the background with a slight streak of motion

options.feel: The viewer feels the speed and then gets a clear look at the best instant.
options.when: Sport, tricks, a jump, a throw: fast action with one peak.
risks: Generators stay slow after the ramp. Write 'back to real time before the landing'.
Say exactly which instant is slow.
options.still: a side-on full-body frame at hip height at the peak of the action, the body sharp in clean side view, the background slightly streaked by the camera's sideways travel
options.snippet: {subject} {action}, tracked side-on at hip height; real time into the move, a short ramp to slow motion at the peak, then back to real time

options.label: D
options.plain: A tight shot from far away, from the side. The face fills the frame and the background melts.
options.movement: locked, or a very slow push-in of a few centimetres
options.placement: exactly side-on, at the subject's chest height, 6 m away, never in front of the face
options.lens_why: A long lens from a distance compresses the space and isolates the face without the wide-angle bend.

light.name: Blade of light
light.plain: A narrow strip of hard light crosses the eyes. The rest falls into shadow.
light.prompt: a dark space with one narrow hard-edged blade of light that crosses the eyes; the rest of the face and body falls into deep shadow; the light comes from one visible gap or window

grade.name: Black and white
grade.plain: No colour. Shape, light and texture do the work.
grade.prompt: black and white with a full tonal range: true black, clean white, fine grain, strong shapes

speed.name: Real time
speed.plain: Normal speed. Fast things are fast.
speed.prompt: real time for the whole shot, fast and crisp, no slow motion
speed.still: a sharp frame with a little natural motion blur on the fastest limb only

options.feel: Tension and focus. The viewer reads the thought on the face.
options.when: The beat before the action, a reaction, a stare-down. For two people, use 2 matched profile shots and cut between them.
risks: Generators turn the face toward the camera. Write 'in profile, the camera never in front'.
Ask for the eyes to move, not the head, or the profile is lost.
options.still: a chest-up frame in clean profile at the subject's chest height, the eyes aimed at something outside the frame, the far background compressed close and out of focus
options.snippet: a chest-up shot of {subject} in clean profile, {action}, from a long lens far away at chest height, the camera never in front of the face; only the eyes move
